aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a tragic accident causes a young chef to lose years of memory, he forgets his current girlfriend and believes he is still in love with his ex-partner.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Shiva, a guarded chef living in Jaipur, overcomes his painful past to fall in love with an IT professional named Sadhana. However, a sudden road accident wipes out recent years of his memory, leaving him with no recollection of Sadhana. Believing he is still in a relationship with his college ex-girlfriend Sahitya, Shiva ends up revisiting old ground while Sadhana is forced to watch the man she loves pursue his past. Together with mutual friends, the trio navigates an emotional journey to heal old wounds and rediscover genuine love.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In Jaipur, guarded chef Shiva runs a South Indian restaurant with his friend Mani. He keeps his heart shielded following a painful breakup from his college romance with Sahitya. Shiva eventually opens up when he meets Sadhana, a vibrant IT professional, and the two slowly cultivate a deep, tender romantic relationship. Just as the couple is preparing for a bright future together, an unexpected accident strikes and wipes out several years from Shiva's memory. Waking up without any memory of Sadhana, Shiva believes he is still deeply in love with Sahitya. To help him recover his memory, the group travels to Ooty, where Sahitya currently runs a tea estate. Heartbroken Sadhana must helplessly stand by and watch Shiva court his former flame all over again. Amidst lingering feelings, awkward situations, and unresolved past baggage, all three individuals are forced to confront their true emotions. Ultimately, Shiva must navigate the delicate boundary between nostalgic attachment and authentic present love to find where his heart truly belongs.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Heartin is a grounded, modern romantic drama that explores the fragile nature of memory and second chances in love. Shiva, a reserved chef in Jaipur, slowly lets down his walls to fall for Sadhana after suffering years of heartbreak from a college breakup. Their blossoming romance is thrown into turmoil when a sudden accident triggers partial amnesia, erasing Shiva's memories of Sadhana entirely while leaving his past feelings for his ex-girlfriend Sahitya fully intact. As the group travels to Ooty in hopes of helping Shiva regain his lost memories, Sadhana is forced into an agonizing position—watching her partner pursue his ex while hoping he remembers their shared love. Avoidant of cheap melodrama, the story focuses on subtle human emotions, maturity, and the complex journey of choosing between comfortable nostalgia and a meaningful present.
